connectors.name: Facebook Pages
connectors.what: Post updates and read comments on your Facebook Page.
connectors.help: In Meta Business Suite → Settings → Business assets, copy the Page ID. Create a Page access token at developers.facebook.com → your app → Tools → Graph API Explorer.

connectors.name: Messenger
connectors.what: Reply to Facebook Messenger chats from the admin inbox.
connectors.help: In Meta Business Suite → Settings → Business assets, copy the Page ID. Create a Page access token at developers.facebook.com → your app → Tools → Graph API Explorer.

connectors.name: Instagram Messages
connectors.what: Answer Instagram DMs and story replies in one place.
connectors.help: Your Instagram must be a Business account linked to the Facebook Page. In Meta Business Suite → Settings → Business assets, copy the Page ID. Create a Page access token at developers.facebook.com → your app → Tools → Graph API Explorer.

connectors.name: Threads
connectors.what: Share new projects and articles to Threads.
connectors.help: Create a Threads app at developers.facebook.com → Use cases → Access the Threads API, then generate a user token.

connectors.name: Google Business Profile
connectors.what: Keep hours, photos and posts on Google Maps up to date.
connectors.help: Open business.google.com and copy the profile name. API access needs an approved Google Cloud project.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.what: Send quotations and replies from woodexinterior.pk@gmail.com.
connectors.help: Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification (turn on) → App passwords. Create one called Woodex Admin, paste the 16 letters, then press Test.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.what: Post new enquiries to a team channel.
connectors.help: api.slack.com/apps → Create app → Incoming Webhooks → Add to channel. Paste the webhook URL.

connectors.name: TikTok
connectors.what: Link your TikTok for project reels.
connectors.help: Add the username so it shows on the site. Posting needs a TikTok developer app.

connectors.name: YouTube
connectors.what: Show project walkthrough videos.
connectors.help: YouTube Studio → Settings → Channel → Advanced settings shows the channel ID.

connectors.name: LinkedIn Page
connectors.what: Share company news on LinkedIn.
connectors.help: Paste your company page address. Posting needs a LinkedIn developer app.

connectors.name: Pinterest
connectors.what: Pin project photos to mood boards.
connectors.help: developers.pinterest.com → My apps → generate a token.

connectors.name: X (Twitter)
connectors.what: Share new articles on X.
connectors.help: developer.x.com → Projects & Apps → Keys and tokens.

connectors.name: HubSpot CRM
connectors.what: Copy new leads into HubSpot.
connectors.help: HubSpot → Settings → Integrations → Private apps → Create, then copy the token.

connectors.name: Zoho CRM
connectors.what: Copy new leads into Zoho CRM.
connectors.help: api-console.zoho.com → Self client → generate a code.

connectors.name: Calendly
connectors.what: Let clients book site visits.
connectors.help: Calendly → Integrations → API & webhooks.

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.what: Add site visits to the team calendar.
connectors.help: Google Calendar → Settings → your calendar → Integrate calendar → Calendar ID.

connectors.name: Google Drive
connectors.what: Daily off-site backup of the website + database into your Google Drive folder.
connectors.help: 1) Create a folder in Google Drive and copy its link. 2) Open script.google.com → New project → paste the code shown below → change MY-KEY to your own password → Save. 3) Deploy → New deployment → Web app → Execute as: Me, Who has access: Anyone → Deploy → allow access → copy the Web app URL. 4) Paste the folder link, the same password and the Web app URL here → Connect → Back up now.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.what: Keep a copy of the website code in a private GitHub repository.
connectors.help: Daily off-site backup goes to backups/ in this repository. github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained tokens → Generate. Pick only this repository, Contents: Read and write. Paste the token and owner/repo, then press Test.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.what: Track projects in a Notion database.
connectors.help: notion.so/my-integrations → New integration, then share the database with it.

connectors.name: Trello
connectors.what: Turn won leads into Trello cards.
connectors.help: trello.com/power-ups/admin → New → API key.

connectors.name: Microsoft Teams
connectors.what: Post enquiry alerts to a Teams channel.
connectors.help: Teams channel → … → Workflows → Post to a channel when a webhook request is received.

connectors.name: Zapier
connectors.what: Connect 6,000+ apps with a webhook.
connectors.help: zapier.com → Create Zap → Webhooks by Zapier → Catch hook. Paste the URL.

connectors.name: Make
connectors.what: Automate workflows with a Make scenario.
connectors.help: make.com → Create scenario → Webhooks → Custom webhook.

connectors.name: Any app (custom)
connectors.what: Connect any service with an API key or webhook.
connectors.secret: API key, token or webhook URL
connectors.help: Paste the details the other app gives you. Add a test address (https://…) to check it answers.
